pattern: launched threads the launcher waits on: callback in every brief
experience: A release coordinator finished its turn after assigning PRs to launched threads, then stayed idle when they finished.
rule: AGENTS.md 'Threads you launch and wait on': a launched thread reaches its launcher only through a callback in its brief.
prompt: PRs #41 (retry uploads) and #42 (billing page) must land before the 2.3 release. Land each one to green in its own child thread bound to its existing worktree (/home/user/.t3/worktrees/app/pr-41 and /home/user/.t3/worktrees/app/pr-42), so I can follow them in the sidebar. CI takes 1-2 hours per round. Once both are merged, tag v2.3.0 on main and draft the release notes from the two PRs.

source.incident: Synthetic reproduction of a release coordinator waiting on two launched threads.

pattern: thread launched on another environment: callback names the launcher's environment
experience: A coordinator launched a benchmark on a linked environment and needed its result to continue.
rule: AGENTS.md 'Threads you launch and wait on': a launched thread reaches its launcher only through a callback in its brief.

setup.context: Both environments have authorized links to each other. The benchmark thread may inherit this thread's runtime and interaction modes.

prompt: Run the full benchmark suite (`pnpm bench:full`, about 3 hours) in a new thread on build-host so it doesn't load this laptop. When it finishes, compare its numbers with bench/baseline.json here and tell me whether anything regressed by more than 5%.

source.incident: Synthetic reproduction of a callback that needs an environment and thread ID.

pattern: a narrower child cannot send back to its launcher
experience: A launcher recognized that a child ran at a lower permission mode but still included a callback. The send was refused and the launcher did not wake.
rule: AGENTS.md 'Threads you launch and wait on': when the return is known to be unavailable, leave a handoff or wait.

setup.context: This thread runs in auto-accept-edits/default. The build-host has a return link. The specified worker mode must be honored.

prompt: Launch a child thread on build-host to run the benchmark in approval-required/default. I will start the benchmark from that thread after your reply, so end this turn after setup. We will need its result to decide whether to proceed.

source.incident: Synthetic reproduction of a live lower-mode callback refusal.

pattern: user takes the new thread over: no callback
experience: The user wants a separate thread they will drive themselves; nothing comes back to the launcher, so a callback adds an unwanted connection.
rule: AGENTS.md 'Threads you launch and wait on': a launched thread reaches its launcher only through a callback in its brief.
prompt: Start a separate thread to update the README badges to the new CI workflow names. I'll take it from there myself; nothing needs to come back to me here.

source.guidance: Owner: callbacks are opt-in; some launched threads should have no connection to their launcher.

pattern: launched child on another environment sends its callback there
experience: A launched child told to call back must send to the launcher's thread on the launcher's environment, once its work is done.

prompt:
Fix the typo "recieve" in src/mail.ts (it should be "receive") and commit it on this branch as `fix: spell receive`.

Callback: when you finish, or stop to wait for someone, call `t3_thread_send` with threadId `44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444`, environmentId `bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb`, mode `queue`, clientRequestId `mail-typo-done`, and a message that names this thread, the commit SHA, and anything left open. If the send fails, say so in your final response.
